name: Interrogation
body:
Interrogators can be suave fast talkers or intimidating bullies. Whatever their means, these s-class investigators are just as effective as any other in getting to the bottom of a case, especially when they have witnesses and potential culprits to whom they can speak.

Interrogation Technique (Ex)

The investigator can use inspiration on any Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sense Motive checks he attempts without spending inspiration, provided he’s trained in that skill.

Know-It-All (Ex)

At 2nd level, the investigator receives a +1 bonus on skill checks for all Knowledge skills in which he is trained. This bonus increases by 1 at 5th level and every 3 investigator levels thereafter, to a maximum of +6 at 17th level.

If he has the perceptive tracking investigator talent, the investigator also adds this bonus on Perception checks to find and follow tracks.

At 5th level, the investigator gains the eidetic recollection investigator talent as a bonus talent, ignoring its prerequisites.

Combat Interrogation (Ex)

At 4th level, the investigator can spend inspiration in combat to interrogate creatures on the spot. At 7th level, and every 3 levels thereafter, he can use this ability once per day without spending inspiration, to a maximum of 5 times per day at 19th level.

He can spend 1 inspiration and attempt a Bluff check to feint as a move action. If he succeds, the target is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC until the end of the investigator’s next turn, then cannot be the target of the same investigator’s combat interrogation for 24 hours.
He can spend 1 inspiration and attempt a Diplomacy check to influence a creature’s attitude as a full-round action that doesn’t provoke attacks of opportunity, then that creature cannot be the target of his combat interrogation again for 24 hours.
He can spend 1 inspiration and attempt an Intimidate check to demoralize a creature as a swift action, then that creature cannot be the target of his combat interrogation again for 24 hours.
He can spend 1 inspiration and make a Sense Motive check as an immediate action when a creature attacks him. If the result is higher than the creature’s attack roll, it misses.
